**What the records I read show (all unreviewed — this delivery is provisional, not a verified package, with 55 open review issues):**

Glucose (offline LIMS results, g/L, elapsed process hours) for CHO-004-R01:

- 19.50 h: 7.133 g/L
- 28.00 h: 7.133 → 6.428 g/L

**What I could not check:**

I did not find any other authorized record (batch, dataset or analysis context) for either run in my searches — the delivery is the sole source.
- The rest of CHO-004-R01's glucose series beyond 44.50 h.

**What would settle it:** paging the rest of that delivery record to the CHO-004-R02 glucose rows, then reporting both series side by side with their times. All figures above are provisional CMO values read from the source files, not verified.

text: Compare glucose between CHO-010-R01 and CHO-010-R02

timing.basis: answer_seconds runs from when the message was sent to when this answer was saved; waiting_seconds is time queued or between retries.

reply:
**Glucose in the two runs is nearly indistinguishable through the first 88.5 hours — every same-time gap I can compute is within 0.22 g/L — after which only CHO-010-R02 remains readable, falling to 3.77 g/L by 185.5 h. Both runs decline steadily through culture.**

Measured glucose (g/L) at elapsed hours, from the Harborview CDMO fed-batch delivery:

| Elapsed h | CHO-010-R01 | CHO-010-R02 |
|---|---|---|
| 0.0 | 7.104 | not in the pages I read |
| 17.5 | 6.740 | 6.608 |
| 25.0 | 6.447 | 6.436 |
| 73.0 | 5.404 | 5.446 |
| 88.5 | 5.106 | 5.321 |
| 95.0 | not read | 5.037 |
| 169.0 | not read | 4.060 |
| 185.5 | not read | 3.770 |

Derived differences (R01 − R02, simple arithmetic on the values above): +0.132 g/L at 17.5 h, +0.011 g/L at 25 h, −0.042 g/L at 73 h, −0.215 g/L at 88.5 h. R01 sits marginally higher on day 1, R02 marginally higher mid-run; none of these gaps is large next to the ~7 → ~4 g/L decline both runs share. My inference is that the two runs ran essentially the same glucose trajectory while I can see both.

What I could not check:

- **The delivery is still in review.** Every value in it is pending review (842 pending values, 54 open missing-field issues, package not verified), so all figures above are unreviewed and may change.
- **I read only part of the delivery record before the budget ended** — roughly the first 170,000 of ~451,000 characters, and one page I had retrieved could not be reopened. So CHO-010-R01 glucose after 88.5 h, CHO-010-R02 glucose at 0 h, and the 95–169 h stretch for R02 are not in what I inspected; other parameters show the runs extend to at least 257.5 h. The late-run comparison stays open until the rest of that record is read, and the review completing would settle whether these unreviewed values stand.
